name: Beyond the Alley
source:
Yao, a lonely lesbian living in a conservative town,  often laments about how much she wants to find a girlfriend, but the world continues to be her biggest enemy. That is, until a being from another world finds her... in an alley.

[From [url=https://goofanader.itch.io/beyond-the-alley]itch.io[/url]]
